titulo_fr: Réserver par écrit : Repérer les informations
intro: Interprets requests, availability and conditions in booking messages. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Interprets requests, availability and conditions in booking messages. It relates the matter to the request and checks the dates, conditions and actions that the message asks to perform.
Attention: « Serait-il possible de… » softens a request; date and duration data limit the scope of the response. In this fragment, «disponible» means «disponible».
